_comment: Maps catalog provider ids to LUMEN provider kinds (crates/providers/src/kind.rs).
Ids are compared after normalization (lowercase, separators removed), so
'together_ai' and 'togetherai' are the same key. A catalog id that already
equals a kind name, or whose base URL equals a kind's default_base_url,
needs no entry here. Prefix aliases match LiteLLM's suffixed ids such as
'vertex_ai-language-models'. extra_capabilities lists what a kind serves
beyond the docs/providers.md tables (prose-only notes there).
